story.iWant: to record from my webcam with a single click
story.soThat: I can capture talking head videos or reactions quickly
story.tasks: - Implement webcam source acquisition (AC: 1, 2) - Implement audio capture (AC: 3) - Create MediaRecorder for webcam (AC: 4) - Implement recording start flow (AC: 5, 6) - Implement recording stop flow (AC: 7, 8, 9) - Implement error handling (AC: 10, 11) - Implement comprehensive logging (AC: 12) - Manage recording state - Write integration tests - Manual testing

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: RecordingService.startRecording() handles 'webcam' mode with auto-selected default webcam
Webcam video stream obtained using getUserMedia with auto-selected videoinput device
Webcam audio automatically captured from same device or default microphone
MediaRecorder instance created with WebM/VP9 codec at 640x480, 30fps, 2.5Mbps
Recording starts immediately after mode selection (within 2 seconds per NFR)
Recorded chunks buffered in memory during capture with periodic flush
All MediaStream tracks properly stopped and cleaned up on recording end
Recording saved to temp directory as `webcam-recording-[timestamp].webm`
RecordingService.stopRecording() returns file path and metadata (duration, resolution)
Error handling for webcam/microphone permission denial with actionable user message
Graceful degradation if webcam unavailable (clear error, no crash)
Logging with [Recording] prefix for all webcam recording operations

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification
doc.snippet: User selects Webcam Only mode, system auto-selects default webcam, records with webcam audio, saves WebM file, auto-imports to media library, auto-places on Track 2 (overlay track).

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification
doc.snippet: Webcam defaults: 640x480 resolution, 30fps frameRate, 2.5Mbps videoBitsPerSecond, 20% size, circular shape (applied in timeline). Audio with echoCancellation and noiseSuppression.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification
doc.snippet: Graceful degradation: if webcam unavailable, display clear error with actionable guidance. MediaRecorder error handling with user-friendly messages.

doc.title: Decision Architecture
doc.snippet: getUserMedia for webcam access, MediaRecorder API for capturing to WebM format.

artifact.reason: Extends Story 5.1 foundation with webcam recording mode, getDefaultWebcam implementation, lower resolution/bitrate MediaRecorder for webcam

node.package: Desktop framework - getUserMedia accessible via renderer context

constraints.constraint: Must use navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia for webcam access
Must use navigator.mediaDevices.enumerateDevices() to find default webcam
Auto-select default webcam = first videoinput device from enumerateDevices()
No webcam selection UI - fully automatic
WebM format with VP9 codec (fallback to VP8)
Must handle NotAllowedError (camera permission), NotFoundError (no webcam), NotReadableError (webcam busy)
Must handle OverconstrainedError if requested resolution unsupported
Graceful error handling - no crashes on device unavailability
Webcam shape (circular) applied in timeline, not during recording

tests.standards: Unit tests with mocked navigator.mediaDevices APIs. Test device enumeration, getUserMedia constraints, error scenarios (no webcam, permissions denied, device busy). Manual testing with real webcam hardware (built-in FaceTime, USB webcams).

ideas.idea: Test startRecording('webcam') calls getDefaultWebcam and getUserMedia
Mock enumerateDevices to return webcam devices, verify first videoinput selected
Test getUserMedia constraints include audio: true with echoCancellation
Test MediaRecorder created with mimeType webm;codecs=vp9, videoBitsPerSecond 2500000
Test chunks buffered with 5s timeslice via mediaRecorder.start(5000)
Test all tracks stopped on stopRecording (verify track.stop() called)
Test NotAllowedError shows "enable in System Preferences > Camera" message
Test NotFoundError displays "No webcam detected" without crashing
